blocks.text: LUCENA CITY—The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) is telling boat owners and operators to comply with maritime safety regulations and secure the necessary permits and registration papers before sailing. The action comes following the capsizing of two unregistered vessels in the waters off northern Quezon on Nov. 3 and 4. “The PCG once again reminded all vessel owners and boat captains to strictly observe maritime safety guidelines,” PCG Northern Quezon Station said Thursday, Nov. 5 The Coast Guard also told the owners and captains to “ensure that all required legal documents are complete before sailing to prevent accidents and other dangers at […]...
